rationale: The plan targets the interaction directly with ~ genotype + treatment + genotype:treatment, extracts the interaction coefficient plus both simple effects via named/list contrasts, sets reference levels explicitly (noting alphabetical defaults would invert both factors), and adds an edgeR QL cross-check appropriate to the noisy n=4 interaction estimate. QC is design-specific and thorough (blind VST, PCA on top 500, distance heatmap, library sizes, per-cell counts) with an explicit flag-not-remove policy justified by cell size. Filtering is minimal and tied to the smallest cell (>=10 counts in >=4 samples) with independent filtering left to results(); normalization is inside the model (median-of-ratios, TMM for edgeR) with an explicit no-pre-scaling constraint. BH at alpha=0.05 per contrast with ashr shrinkage (correctly chosen over apeglm for the composite KO contrast) and selection by padj; GSEA is preranked on the full tested list ranked by the Wald statistic with a stated universe, 15-500 size window, seed, and collection version, though collection versions are only promised rather than pinned. The report enumerates versions, formula, contrasts, thresholds, counts, and a candid power caveat about the interaction at n=4.
